prompt: Show me what whales are buying this quarter
expected_output: 13F-only mode run, sorted by net volume, with whale conviction scores

assertions.name: uses_13f_only_mode
assertions.description: Output must reference or invoke 13F-only mode (not full tracker, not congress)
assertions.check: output mentions '13F' or '13f-only' or 'institutional whales' or 'sec13f'

assertions.name: mentions_specific_whales
assertions.description: Output must name at least 2 named institutional whales (e.g. Berkshire, Bridgewater)
assertions.check: output contains at least 2 of: 'Berkshire', 'Bridgewater', 'Pershing', 'Soros', 'ARK', 'Tiger', 'Citadel', 'Two Sigma', 'Baupost', 'Renaissance', 'Lone Pine', 'Maverick', 'Coatue', 'Viking', 'D1 Capital', 'Third Point', 'Druckenmiller', 'Whale Rock', 'Greenlight', 'Appaloosa', 'ValueAct', 'Trian', 'Duquesne'

assertions.name: references_net_volume_or_conviction
assertions.description: Output must include net volume or conviction metric for ranking picks
assertions.check: output contains 'net volume' or 'conviction' or 'purchases' or 'sales' or 'BULLISH' or 'BEARISH'

assertions.name: no_trade_execution_imperative
assertions.description: Output must NOT include 'buy' or 'sell' imperative language directed at the user
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'you should buy' or 'you should sell' or 'I recommend' or 'I would buy' or 'I would sell' (case-insensitive)
